edges.definition: Relates a fact to a patent that it describes. A grant can cover several patents.
edges.label: aboutPatent

edges.definition: The notice that announces a proposed grant.
edges.label: announcedIn

edges.definition: The NASA center that manages the patent.
edges.label: center

edges.definition: A co-owner that an ownership record lists.
edges.label: coOwner

edges.definition: Relates a grant to every field its rights reach: the named field and every narrower field beneath it. A reasoner derives this property from skos:narrower, so the hierarchy decides coverage.
edges.label: coversField

edges.definition: Relates a grant to every territory its rights reach: the named territory and every country beneath it.
edges.label: coversTerritory

edges.definition: How exclusive the grant is. An executed grant has exactly one. A proposed grant from a notice that offers several types has several.
edges.label: exclusivityType

edges.definition: The agreement that creates an executed grant.
edges.label: executedUnder

edges.definition: The field that the grant names. A notice may name none.
edges.label: fieldOfUse

edges.definition: The document that holds the clause.
edges.label: inDocument

edges.definition: The legal state that a registry reports.
edges.label: legalState

edges.definition: The party that holds or asks for the grant.
edges.label: licensee

edges.definition: A territory in which a licensee may sit when the technology is export-restricted.
edges.label: permittedTerritory

edges.definition: The executed grant that a royalty term belongs to.
edges.label: royaltyOf

edges.definition: Links a synthetic agreement to the real notice whose patents, exclusivity, field, and territory it copies.
edges.label: seededFrom

edges.definition: The clause that a fact was read from. A fact can point to several clauses.
edges.label: sourceClause

edges.definition: A correction supersedes the fact it replaces. The replaced fact stays in the graph with a supersededAt time.
edges.label: supersedes

edges.definition: The territory that the grant names. A notice may name none.
edges.label: territory

nodes.definition: A governed state change. Each action has typed inputs, a permission check, a validation step, a target named graph, and a queryable provenance record.
nodes.label: Action

nodes.definition: A standing approval that stands in for a person. The bulk-load policy approves public system-of-record data. It never approves a fact that a language model extracted.
nodes.label: Approval policy

nodes.definition: A steward promotes a candidate fact to the approved graph and records the reason.
nodes.label: Approve fact

nodes.comment: Valid time answers whether a grant applies on a date. Recording time answers what the system knew when it decided. Reproducing a past verdict needs both.

datatypeProperties.definition: The date the application was filed.
datatypeProperties.name: filingDate

datatypeProperties.definition: The moment the system recorded the fact. A rerun that uses a recording cutoff sees only facts recorded at or before the cutoff.
datatypeProperties.name: recordedAt

datatypeProperties.definition: The moment a correction replaced the fact. After a recording cutoff that falls on or after this moment, the fact no longer counts.
datatypeProperties.name: supersededAt

datatypeProperties.definition: First day on which the fact holds in the world.
datatypeProperties.name: validFrom

datatypeProperties.definition: Last day on which the fact holds. Absent means the fact has no stated end.
datatypeProperties.name: validTo

nodes.definition: A statement that the system records with two times: the valid time, when the statement holds in the world, and the recording time, when the system learned it. A correction supersedes a fact and never deletes it.
nodes.label: Bitemporal fact

nodes.definition: A run that loaded system-of-record data from a public registry or dataset under a standing approval policy.
nodes.label: Bulk load

datatypeProperties.definition: What the clause states, for example grant, field, territory, term, or exclusivity.
datatypeProperties.name: clauseKind

datatypeProperties.definition: Zero-based character offset where the clause ends, exclusive.
datatypeProperties.name: spanEnd

datatypeProperties.definition: Zero-based character offset where the clause begins in the document's full text.
datatypeProperties.name: spanStart

datatypeProperties.definition: The words in the span. A citation checker compares quoted text with this value.
datatypeProperties.name: spanText

nodes.definition: A character span inside a source document. A clause is the evidence that a fact points to, so a reader can open the document at the exact words.
nodes.label: Clause

nodes.definition: A structured request for a verdict: patent, licensee, field of use, territory, term, and exclusivity type. Gate 2 adds its properties.
nodes.label: Clearance request

nodes.definition: An organization, other than NASA, that the USPTO assignment records or an ownership record name as an owner of a patent.
nodes.label: Co-owner

datatypeProperties.definition: What the co-owner consented to, in words.
datatypeProperties.name: consentScope

nodes.definition: A co-owner's consent to license the patent.
nodes.label: Consent record

nodes.definition: A steward supersedes an approved fact with a new one. The original stays in the graph.
nodes.label: Correct fact

nodes.definition: The stored result of one clearance request: the rule findings, the combiner policy, the release, the recording cutoff, and the verdict. Gate 2 adds its properties.
nodes.label: Decision

nodes.definition: A concept in the exclusivity scheme: exclusive, partially exclusive, co-exclusive, or non-exclusive.
nodes.label: Exclusivity type

datatypeProperties.definition: The largest number of co-exclusive licensees the agreement allows. Absent means no cap is recorded.
datatypeProperties.name: coExclusiveCap

datatypeProperties.definition: The date both parties signed the agreement.
datatypeProperties.name: executedOn

datatypeProperties.definition: True when the agreement lets the licensee grant sublicenses.
datatypeProperties.name: sublicenseAllowed

nodes.definition: A grant that a signed agreement creates. It states one exclusivity type, a field of use, a territory, and a term.
nodes.label: Executed grant

nodes.definition: The export-control status of the technology a patent covers. The class is abstract: a classification is either restricted or unrestricted.
nodes.label: Export classification

datatypeProperties.definition: The identifier of the model or extractor that read the facts out of text.
datatypeProperties.name: extractionModel

nodes.definition: A run that read candidate facts out of document text. A language model or a deterministic extractor can perform it. A steward must approve its facts before they affect a verdict.
nodes.label: Extraction

nodes.definition: An activity that produced facts: a bulk load of registry data, an extraction from a document, or a run of the synthetic generator.
nodes.label: Fact generation

nodes.comment: Fields of use are SKOS concepts, not OWL subclasses. Subclassing would assert that every instance of a narrow field is an instance of the broad field, which is a claim about sets that the business does not make. The business edits this hierarchy as a policy.
nodes.definition: A concept in the field-of-use scheme. Broader means wider rights coverage.
nodes.label: Field of use

nodes.definition: The filing date of a patent application, used when no registry supplies an expiration date. A rule that uses it must label the resulting expiration as derived.
nodes.label: Filing record

nodes.definition: The synthetic-data generator, as a software agent.
nodes.label: Generator

nodes.comment: Modeled as a class, in the pattern of the W3C note on n-ary relations, because a binary property cannot carry six participants.

datatypeProperties.definition: The field of use as the document words it, before any mapping to a concept.
datatypeProperties.name: fieldOfUseText

datatypeProperties.definition: The licensee's name exactly as the source document spells it. Entity resolution compares this string with the names of licensee nodes.
datatypeProperties.name: licenseeNameAsWritten

nodes.definition: A license that relates a patent, a licensee, a field of use, a territory, a term, and an exclusivity type at once. The class is abstract: every grant is either proposed or executed.
nodes.label: Grant

nodes.definition: A concept in the legal-state scheme: in force, lapsed, term ended, abandoned, not granted, or application.
nodes.label: Legal state

nodes.definition: A signed patent license agreement. Only an agreement creates an executed grant.
nodes.label: License agreement

datatypeProperties.definition: A patent number, application serial, or case number that the notice names, including identifiers of patents that are not in the graph.
datatypeProperties.name: namesIdentifier

nodes.definition: A Federal Register notice of NASA's intent to grant a patent license. A notice announces a proposed grant and opens an objection window. It never proves that a license exists.
nodes.label: License notice

datatypeProperties.definition: Another spelling of the licensee's name that appears in some document.
datatypeProperties.name: nameVariant

nodes.definition: An organization that holds, or asks for, a license. Different documents name the same licensee in different ways, so each spelling can be a separate node until a steward links them with owl:sameAs.
nodes.label: Licensee

datatypeProperties.definition: The short center code, for example LaRC.
datatypeProperties.name: centerCode

nodes.definition: A NASA field center or headquarters that holds patents.
nodes.label: NASA center

nodes.definition: Counsel records a different outcome with a written justification. The original decision stays unchanged.
nodes.label: Override verdict

nodes.comment: Without this record, the absence of co-owners proves nothing under the open world assumption.

datatypeProperties.definition: True when the record asserts that its co-owner list is exhaustive. False means the record knows only some co-owners.
datatypeProperties.name: coOwnerListIsComplete

nodes.definition: A statement about who co-owns a patent. The record says whether its co-owner list is exhaustive. An exhaustive list with no entries is an explicit negative fact: the patent has no co-owners.
nodes.label: Ownership record

nodes.comment: Keeping status out of the Patent node lets two sources disagree about the same patent without overwriting each other, and lets a later fact supersede an earlier one.

datatypeProperties.definition: The application serial number as digits, for example 13033085.
datatypeProperties.name: applicationSerial

datatypeProperties.definition: The NASA case number, for example LAR-18232-1. A divisional or continuation keeps its suffix.
datatypeProperties.name: caseNumber

datatypeProperties.definition: The United States patent number without punctuation. Absent while the patent has not issued.
datatypeProperties.name: patentNumber

datatypeProperties.definition: The category that the NASA Technology Transfer portal assigns to the technology. The top level of the field-of-use scheme reuses these categories.
datatypeProperties.name: t2Category

datatypeProperties.definition: The NASA technology readiness level, from 1 to 9, when the portal's description states one.
datatypeProperties.name: technologyReadinessLevel

datatypeProperties.definition: The technology record identifier on the NASA Technology Transfer portal, for example LEW-TOPS-161.
datatypeProperties.name: topsId

nodes.definition: A United States patent or patent application that NASA owns, alone or jointly. The class holds identity only. Legal status, ownership, and licenses are separate facts about the patent.
nodes.label: Patent

datatypeProperties.definition: How the expiration date was found.
datatypeProperties.name: expirationBasis

datatypeProperties.definition: The date the patent expires or expired, according to the registry or the computation named in expirationBasis.
datatypeProperties.name: expirationDate

datatypeProperties.definition: True when the date was computed from other dates, for example filing date plus 20 years. A derived date appears on the verdict card with that label.
datatypeProperties.name: expirationIsDerived

datatypeProperties.definition: The date the patent issued.
datatypeProperties.name: grantDate

datatypeProperties.definition: True when the prosecution history shows a terminal disclaimer. A disclaimer can shorten the term below the computed date, so a rule should treat the expiration as an upper bound.
datatypeProperties.name: hasTerminalDisclaimer

datatypeProperties.definition: The date the registry recorded an expiry for unpaid maintenance fees.
datatypeProperties.name: lapseDate

datatypeProperties.definition: The date the registry accepted a late fee and revived a lapsed patent. Third parties may hold intervening rights for acts between the lapse date and this date.
datatypeProperties.name: reinstatedOn

datatypeProperties.definition: The status as the registry words it.
datatypeProperties.name: statusText

datatypeProperties.definition: Days that the USPTO added to the 20-year term for its own delays.
datatypeProperties.name: termAdjustmentDays

nodes.definition: What a registry reports about whether a patent is alive: its legal state, its expiration date, and how that date was found. Two registries can each report a status for the same patent.
nodes.label: Patent legal status

nodes.definition: The ingestion pipeline writes candidate facts to the candidate graph.
nodes.label: Propose facts

datatypeProperties.definition: Whether the notice states a field (stated), says only that fields may be limited (limited_unspecified), or says nothing (not_mentioned).
datatypeProperties.name: fieldOfUseStatus

datatypeProperties.definition: The last day on which NASA accepts objections. Until this day passes, rule R4 returns PENDING.
datatypeProperties.name: objectionDeadline

datatypeProperties.definition: How the deadline was found: a date the notice states, or the publication date plus a stated number of days.
datatypeProperties.name: objectionDeadlineBasis

datatypeProperties.definition: The date the notice appeared in the Federal Register.
datatypeProperties.name: publishedOn

nodes.definition: A grant that a license notice announces. It records intent. The objection window can end without a license.
nodes.label: Proposed grant

nodes.definition: The ontology owner activates a release bundle after the release gate passes.
nodes.label: Publish release

nodes.definition: A record from a patent registry or dataset, such as a USPTO file wrapper or the NASA Patents snapshot.
nodes.label: Registry record

nodes.definition: A steward discards a candidate fact and records the reason.
nodes.label: Reject fact

nodes.definition: Export controls apply. The classification lists the territories that a licensee may sit in.
nodes.label: Restricted export classification

datatypeProperties.definition: The smallest royalty the licensee pays in a year, in U.S. dollars.
datatypeProperties.name: minimumAnnualRoyaltyUSD

datatypeProperties.definition: The running royalty as a percentage of net sales.
datatypeProperties.name: royaltyPercent

nodes.definition: The confidential royalty terms of an executed grant. Royalty terms live in their own named graph, so graph-level access control can hide them from licensing managers.
nodes.label: Royalty term

datatypeProperties.definition: The cleaned document text. Clause spans index this text by character offset.
datatypeProperties.name: fullText

datatypeProperties.definition: The moment the pipeline fetched the document.
datatypeProperties.name: retrievedAt

datatypeProperties.definition: The repository path of the stored copy of the document.
datatypeProperties.name: storedAt

nodes.definition: A document or registry record from which a fact was read.
nodes.label: Source document

nodes.definition: A person who approves, edits, rejects, or corrects facts.
nodes.label: Steward

nodes.definition: A licensing manager asks for a verdict.
nodes.label: Submit clearance request

datatypeProperties.definition: The seed that makes a generator run reproducible.
datatypeProperties.name: generatorSeed

nodes.definition: A run of the seeded synthetic generator. Every fact it produces is synthetic, and the prov:wasGeneratedBy link to this activity is the label that says so.
nodes.label: Synthetic generation

datatypeProperties.definition: The two-letter country code. Regions have none.
datatypeProperties.name: iso3166Alpha2

nodes.definition: A concept in the territory scheme: the world, a commercial region, or a country with an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
nodes.label: Territory

nodes.definition: No export controls apply.
nodes.label: Unrestricted export classification
